parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  patient_id: $json.patient_id || "Not provided",
  prediction: $json.prediction || $json.predicted_class_aami || "Not provided",
  predicted_class_aami: $json.predicted_class_aami || $json.prediction || "Not provided",
  confidence: $json.confidence ?? 0,

  qrs_shap_signed: $json.qrs_shap_signed ?? 0,
  p_wave_shap_signed: $json.p_wave_shap_signed ?? 0,
  t_wave_shap_signed: $json.t_wave_shap_signed ?? 0,

  qrs_importance: $json.qrs_importance ?? Math.abs($json.qrs_shap_signed ?? 0),
  p_wave_importance: $json.p_wave_importance ?? Math.abs($json.p_wave_shap_signed ?? 0),
  t_wave_importance: $json.t_wave_importance ?? Math.abs($json.t_wave_shap_signed ?? 0),

  dominant_ecg_region: $json.dominant_ecg_region || "QRS",
  qrs_direction: $json.qrs_direction || "neutral",
  p_wave_direction: $json.p_wave_direction || "neutral",
  t_wave_direction: $json.t_wave_direction || "neutral",

  rr_variance_proxy: $json.rr_variance_proxy ?? $json.normalized_entropy ?? 0,
  risk_flag: $json.uncertainty_level || $json.risk_flag || "Unknown",
  ehr_triage_note: $json.ehr_triage_note || $json.pipeline_recommendation || "No EHR note provided",
  ecg_lead: $json.ecg_lead || "MLII",
  true_label: $json.true_class_aami || $json.true_label || "Not provided",
  correct: $json.correct === true ? 1 : 0,
  run_id: $json.run_id || "Not provided"
}) }}
